_comment: The invoicing package's rights, shipped as a library layer (docs/commerce_PRD.md §4.8). They name only its own types
and only @authenticated: no slot, so no application has to bind anything. Every row is narrowed by InvoicingAccess
(the buyer's own documents; a seller's Owners, Admins and finance members its documents; the platform organization
every row), so the rights alone show nothing. Invoices are never altered (§4.15): only QueryRead is granted.
Opt out of all of these with "libraries": { "commerce-invoicing": false }.
